title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 11.5 Matrices and Matrix Operations: Find the sum and difference of two matrices.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 11.5 Matrices and Matrix Operations: Find the sum and difference of two matrices.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "11.5 Matrices and Matrix Operations", prints these objectives: "Find the sum and difference of two matrices." "Find scalar multiples of a matrix." "Find the product of two matrices.". The section text says: "Two club soccer teams, the Wildcats and the Mud Cats, are hoping to obtain new equipment for an upcoming season. Table 1 shows the needs of both teams." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
